generic_domain.justification: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a fundamental paradigm in machine learning that addresses decision-making problems. Both Model-Based RL and Model-Free RL are subsets of RL, with the distinction lying in their approaches: Model-Based RL uses an explicit model of the environment to make decisions, while Model-Free RL learns policies without such models. Therefore, RL serves as the overarching domain that encompasses both approaches.
